scope: Current README results and seven figures, both current posters, and overlapping manuscript/presentation results.
historical_provenance_policy: Unknown original training revisions remain null. code_reference_revision identifies audited code, not a proven training revision. Upstream artifacts are optional for cached reproduction but checked when present.

results.title: Dense supervised and sparse PINN state errors
results.metric_definition: Mean of 28 saved state-wise relative L2 errors. Each error is norm(prediction-reference)/norm(reference). Multiply by 100 for percent.
results.denominator: 7 states times 4 regimes. Dense uses 100 labels; sparse uses 40 observation times.
limitations: Aggregation is recomputed from saved per-state scores, not checkpoint predictions.
Training objectives differ. This is not an isolated data-size ablation.

results.title: Matched ten-condition inverse parameter recovery
results.metric_definition: Count parameters with abs(estimate-truth)/abs(truth) strictly below 0.1 per regime, then sum counts.
results.denominator: 36 parameters times 4 regimes = 144 pairs; ten conditions in both methods.
limitations: Integral residual, relative weighting, fixed collocation and multiple starts changed together. This does not isolate the residual.
Point-estimate recovery on synthetic data does not establish structural identifiability or calibrated uncertainty.

results.title: Hybrid and control on common remaining parameters
results.metric_definition: Intersect recovered keys per variant and regime, verify matching truth, and count errors strictly below 10%. Function NRMSE is RMS(learned-truth)/RMS(truth) on the observed-support grid.
results.denominator: RA-HOXA5: 34 times 4 = 136. Beta-MYC: 34 times 4 = 136. APC loss: 35 times 4 = 140.
limitations: RA/MYC functions are jointly fitted per regime. APC has additional mutation calibration data, then a frozen shared function; its 0.1195% NRMSE is one shared score.
Different terms and protocols are not an isolated joint-versus-frozen ablation.
Frozen-state refinement was effectively a no-op in these runs.

results.title: Full and conditional eight-parameter Fisher analysis
results.metric_definition: I=J^T J/sigma^2 in log-parameter coordinates, including thetaP. Diagonalize saved matrices. Null eigenvalues: <1. Nonidentifiable: null participation>0.5; weak: null participation>0.2 or soft participation>0.5; otherwise identifiable. Soft eigenvalues: <max(eigenvalue)*1e-4 excluding null.
results.denominator: 7 states times 10 conditions times 200 times = 14000 observations. Full dimension 36; reduced dimension 8; sigma=0.002.
limitations: Local sensitivity at truth, not global or structural identifiability.
Reduced analysis fixes the other 28 parameters at truth and omits their uncertainty. Reduced-parameter PINN recovery has not been tested.
Eigen-direction counts and individual-parameter counts differ. Negative roundoff eigenvalues are clipped to zero; plots have a 1e-4 display floor.

results.title: MYC depletion and prospective HOXA13 screens
results.metric_definition: Convert saved per-parameter basal relative errors to percent and compare with the independent hybrid_basal_err field. Compare k=0 MYC doses; report prospective protocols and the failed W counterexample.
results.denominator: MYC: 11 conditions per arm, two starts. Prospective: 10 baseline conditions, 11 with depletion. One host equation fitted to exact states.
limitations: Parameters outside the fitted equation are fixed at truth.
Function recovery can worsen while basal recovery improves. Function NRMSE uses each design's observed support.
No noisy sparse state estimates or biological measurements were used. Model interventions are not validated laboratory protocols.
This report audits saved error dictionaries without deserializing the original fitted-parameter checkpoints.

results.title: Inverse HMC coverage and sampling checks
results.metric_definition: Recompute 2.5/97.5 percentiles and truth coverage from constrained draws. Historical ESS sums raw log/logit autocorrelation until the first lag <0.05. Gates require median ESS>=200 and >=90% parameter coverage.
results.denominator: 36 parameters. Presentation Normal/Severe: 2000 draws each from 20260712_204532. Hybrid-poster Normal: 3000 draws from 20260713_204442.
limitations: All shown inverse chains fail gates; interval widths are unreliable.
The posterior conditions on frozen state networks and omits state-network uncertainty.
The historical single-chain ESS is reproduced for audit, not endorsed as a modern multi-chain diagnostic. R-hat is unavailable.
Presentation code manually changes Normal coverage to 18/36. Samples and summaries give 19/36, used here and in the first poster.

results.title: Forward Bayesian predictive coverage
results.metric_definition: Recompute per-state RMSE and fraction of reference times inside saved latent-function 95% bands. Check summaries. Report saved energy ESS and beta-prediction ESS separately.
results.denominator: 7 states times 4 regimes, each on a saved 2000-time grid. Training uses 40 noisy observation times.
limitations: Coverage of one synthetic trajectory is not repeated-experiment interval calibration.
ESS is taken from saved summaries because full weight-chain histories are unavailable with predictive exports.
Latent bands exclude observation noise; posterior predictive bands add observation noise.

results.title: Normal MYC/APC treated and untreated PINN errors
results.metric_definition: 100*norm(PINN-Radau)/norm(Radau) per state over all 6000 saved times. Verify cached errors and DR=[0,1.5].
results.denominator: 2 conditions times 7 states. First poster displays MYC/APC. Both conditions belong to the same ten-condition inverse fit.
limitations: Untreated changes only DR=0; circadian forcing remains active.
Scores use the complete horizon, not held-out support or oscillation-relative errors.
The original export evaluated checkpoints and Radau. Reproduction only reads saved arrays.

results.title: Saved Adam loss and selected parameter errors
results.metric_definition: Verify total=data+lambda_phys*physics+20*IC at each recorded epoch. Compute W/thetaP relative errors at those same epochs.
results.denominator: 11 actual Adam checkpoints from selected Normal start; losses average ten conditions.
limitations: Lines connect saved checkpoints; no intermediate history is synthesized.
L-BFGS follows Adam and is included in final state fits, not these Adam histories.
Original histories retain all parameters including epsilonM; the poster shows only W/thetaP.

results.title: Historical five-constraint MYC screen
results.metric_definition: Min/max of rounded basal-error percentages transcribed from the dated note. These are not newly calculated fit errors.
results.denominator: Five forms, Normal regime, one start.
limitations: Complete original five-form run mapping was not recovered. screen_atlas contains gated/sc cases, not all five forms.
The existing poster claim is preserved with its provenance gap and must not be presented as an independently reproduced fit result.
